games.name: (ANCIENT SHRINE) Crawl [ALPHA]
games.desc:
Thank you all for supporting the game. It has meant the world to me how much support my small project has gotten. 

Feel free to experience crawl before I fixed it.

You are a traveler from a distant warrior land, destined to become the king of your realm.  Abandoned by your ambition to become mightier than God, you ended up here, where you would sooner perish, but by some miracle, a stroke of luck, you have been given a second chance to become stronger.  Battle through vast dungeons to obtain powerful gear and spells to claim your promised inheritance.  Fight alone or with your friends and companions to become your true potential. Walk away from this as you emerge into a being greater than God, but before you walk, you must crawl.
